mapper.insert: INSERT INTO favorite_benefit (member_no, benefit_no) VALUES (#{memberNo}, #{benefitNo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_no = member_no
mapper.select:
SELECT fb.benefit_no AS benefitNo, b.plcy_no AS plcyNo, b.plcy_nm AS plcyNm, b.category_code AS categoryCode, bc.category_name AS categoryName, b.sprvsn_inst_cd_nm AS sprvsnInstCdNm, b.apply_start_date AS applyStartDate, b.apply_end_date AS applyEndDate, b.aply_prd_se_cd AS aplyPrdSeCd, b.is_active AS isActive,
CASE WHEN b.is_active = 'N' THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN b.aply_prd_se_cd = '0057003' THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN b.apply_end_date IS NOT NULL AND b.apply_end_date < CURDATE() THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN b.apply_end_date IS NULL THEN 'ALWAYS' ELSE 'OPEN' END AS benefitStatus,
fb.saved_at AS savedAt
FROM favorite_benefit fb JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_no = fb.benefit_no JOIN benefit_category bc ON bc.category_code = b.category_code
WHERE fb.member_no = #{memberNo}
ORDER BY fb.saved_at DESC, fb.favorite_no DESC
